title: Learn Hip Hop Dance: The Dougie

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the dance into small, manageable components, focusing on feet, torso, and arms separately. He uses a repetitive, encouraging tone to guide the student through each step.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher breaks down the footwork.
The teacher breaks down the torso movement.
The teacher breaks down the arm movement.
The teacher practices the full move with music.
The teacher adds a double step to the move.

metaphors: like you want to do the snake
like you're trying to look at the heel of your sneaker

steps_taught.name: The Dougie
steps_taught.description: A hip-hop dance involving a side-to-side step with a dip and arm movement.

what_works: The teacher breaks the dance into small, manageable parts.
The teacher uses a split-screen to show both the full body and the feet.
what_hinders: The teacher's verbal cues are sometimes inconsistent with the counts.

quotes.text: I'm going to break that down for you.
If you noticed, in between each step, there's a dip.
Whenever you go to your dip, that's when you come back center.
All you're doing is you're taking a little look.
As you get comfortable, you start playing with it.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of a white background and explains the dance.
The teacher demonstrates the footwork, showing a side-to-side step.
The teacher demonstrates the torso movement, showing a slight lean.
The teacher demonstrates the arm movement, showing a pushing motion.
The teacher practices the full move with music.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a split-screen to show both the full body and the feet, which is helpful for learning the footwork.
